source.quoted_text: Sch I Art. 25(b) PRIOR to Mah. 59 of 2017 (per the IGR amendment footnotes): (i) Municipal Corporation / urban — 5%; (ii) Municipal Council / Nagar Panchayat / MMRDA rural / Influence Areas — 4% (raised to 5% by Mah. 59 of 2017 s.2(a)(i) w.e.f. 7-9-2017); (iii) Gram Panchayat — 3% (raised to 4% by Mah. 59 of 2017 s.2(a)(ii) w.e.f. 7-9-2017); (a) movable — 3%. Back-catalogue version for historical/adjudication mode (Flow D).

act: Maharashtra Stamp Act, 1958 (Bom. Act LX of 1958), Schedule I

source.ref: Maharashtra Stamp Act, 1958, Sch. I Art. 25(b) (as amended by Mah. Act 59 of 2017, w.e.f. 7-9-2017)
source.quoted_text: Sch I Art. 25 (both columns, IGR text as modified to 1-Jun-2022): 'CONVEYANCE ... On the true market value of the property which is the subject matter of the Conveyance — (a) if relating to movable property — 3 per cent of the market value; (b) if relating to immovable property situated — (i) within the limits of any municipal Corporation or any cantonment area annexed to it or any urban area not mentioned in sub clause (ii) — 5 per cent of the market value; (ii) within the limits of any Municipal council or Nagar Panchayat or Cantonment area annexed to it, or any rural area within the limits of the MMRDA, or the Influence Areas ... — 5 per cent [subst. for 4 per cent by Mah. 59 of 2017 w.e.f. 7-9-2017] of the market value; (iii) within the limits of any Gram Panchayat area or any such area not mentioned in sub-clause (ii) — 4 per cent [subst. for 3 per cent by Mah. 59 of 2017] of the market value; (c) if relating to both movable and immovable property — the same duty as is payable under clauses (a) and (b).' STAMP DUTY ONLY — Maharashtra metro cess (1%) and Local Body Tax are separate surcharges (see PENDING note). Base is TRUE MARKET VALUE (MH uses market value, not higher-of-consideration; user supplies it, ready-reckoner DB out of scope).

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: HIGH for the Schedule stamp rate (official IGR text quoted in full). area_type: municipal_corporation / municipal_council / mmrda_rural / influence_area / urban → 5% (default); gram_panchayat → 4%; movable → 3%. PENDING_VERIFICATION (surcharges): Maharashtra levies (a) a 1% Metro Cess / transport surcharge in MMR, Pune, Nagpur, Nashik etc., and (b) 1% Local Body Tax (LBT) in some corporations, ON TOP of the Schedule rate — NOT yet encoded (need the specific surcharge notifications and their area lists); the effective Mumbai rate is ~6-7%, not 5%. Encode these as separate modifiers once sourced, mirroring the Delhi transfer-duty pattern. effective_from 2017-09-07 = the Act 59/2017 rate change; the pre-2017 version (council 4% / gram 3%) is a back-catalogue version to add for historical mode (M2 batched-by-year).
